extensions.name: field_read_permission
extensions.description:
The field_read_permission annotation defines the required permission to read a field during a list- or get operation.
If the permission is defined and the caller does not have the required permissions, the field is excluded
from the response by setting it to either its zero value (for non-optional fields) or to null.
extensions.label: optional

extensions.name: field_type
extensions.description:
The field_type annotation can be used to define a custom field_type that results in a special treatment on field
updates.
extensions.label: optional

extensions.name: field_update_permission
extensions.description:
The field_update_permission annotation defines the required permission to update a field using a Update operation.
If the permission is defined and the caller does not have the required permissions, a PERMISSION_DENIED
error will be returned.
extensions.label: optional

fields.name: id
fields.description: The UUID that is used to uniquely identify a Document.

fields.name: finalizers
fields.description:
Finalizers are indicators that certain background actions for a Document must be performed before the
Document resource can be deleted from the Database.
For example, removing the uploaded file from the storage volume.
fields.label: repeated

fields.name: publisher
fields.description:
Reference to the cortex.exonex.io/Publisher that published the file.
This field is immutable once set and can be used to evaluate policies, e.g. regarding procession.

fields.name: file_upload_completed
fields.description: Indicates if the upload of the file for this document has already been finished.

fields.name: file_mime_type
fields.description:
The MIME type of the uploaded file.
This field is immutable once set and will be used as restriction when generating Upload URLs.

fields.name: file_size_bytes
fields.description:
The size of the uploaded file in bytes.
This field may be an estimate until the upload of the file is completed.

fields.name: file_storage_volume
fields.description: Name of the volume that stores the file.

fields.name: file_storage_key
fields.description: Key or path on the storage volume where the file of this document is stored.

fields.name: version
fields.description: An increasing counter that is used for optimistic concurrency locking.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The time this document has been created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The time this document has been updated the last time.
